csrf.origin_mismatch: Cross-site request refused: origin {origin} is not the configured public origin.
csrf.origin_missing: Cross-site request refused: the request has no Origin or Referer header.

directory.ca_invalid: ca_pem is not a PEM X.509 certificate
directory.ca_private_key: ca_pem must be a certificate, not a private key
directory.enabled_needs_url: an enabled configuration needs at least one directory URL
directory.enabled_needs_valid_url: an enabled configuration needs at least one valid directory URL
directory.stale: The directory configuration is stale. Reload it and retry.
directory.start_tls_with_ldaps: start_tls must be false for an ldaps:// URL
directory.test_needs_url: the test needs a directory URL
directory.url_too_long: a directory URL is longer than 512 characters
directory.urls_max: at most {max} directory URLs are allowed

login.directory_unavailable: The directory server is unavailable. Sign-in was not completed.

password.equals_username: password must not equal the username
password.ldap_directory: LDAP accounts change their password in the directory, not here.
password.local_only: only a local account can change its password
password.too_long: password must be at most 72 bytes
password.too_short: password must be at least 12 characters

session.must_change_password: A password change is required before any other request.

user.email_taken: A user with that email already exists.
user.exists: A user with that username or email already exists.
user.last_admin: the last active user holding admin:* cannot be disabled or lose that role
user.ldap_no_password: An LDAP user has no password here.
user.local_needs_password: A local user needs an initial password.
user.reset_local_only: Only a local account can have its password reset here.
user.source_invalid: auth_source must be LOCAL or LDAP
user.username_taken: A user with that username already exists.

username.shape: username must be 1 to 255 characters without spaces or control characters

evidence.acceptable: The rule is enabled and its health is acceptable.
evidence.below_floor: Mapping confidence {confidence} is below the {floor} floor; recorded but not counted toward coverage.
evidence.dependency_degraded: The rule''s required telemetry is unavailable, so it cannot fire.
evidence.disabled: The rule is disabled, so it provides no active coverage.
evidence.inactive: The rule has not fired within the inactivity window.
evidence.never_observed: The rule has never been observed firing.
evidence.not_established: The rule''s health has not been established yet.

rollup.all_detecting: All {enabled} enabled rules mapped to this technique are detecting.
rollup.all_excluded: Every rule mapped to this technique is disabled or discounted, so there is no active detection.
rollup.none_detecting: {degraded} of {enabled} enabled rules are not currently detecting.
rollup.not_established: Rule health has not been established for the mapped rules.
rollup.some_degraded: {working} of {enabled} enabled rules are detecting; {degraded} are degraded.
rollup.some_unestablished: {working} of {enabled} enabled rules are detecting; the rest are not yet established.
rollup.unmapped: No rule is mapped to this technique.

customrule.name_exists: a custom rule named ''{name}'' already exists
customrule.watch_value_gone: the property-watch value no longer exists (its watch changed or was deleted while the rule was saved); reload and choose a value again

dashboard.changed_since_opened: this dashboard changed since you opened it
dashboard.name_taken: you already have a dashboard named ''{name}''
dashboard.owner_limit: the limit is {limit} dashboards per owner
dashboard.owner_only: only the owner or an administrator can change this dashboard

dimension.unpopulated: field is not populated for this log source

action.change_pins: change the scope, properties or pins
action.change_scope: change the scope or properties (the watch version would change)

dependency.raced: cannot {action}: a custom rule pinned a value of this watch while the request ran; reload and try again
dependency.refused: cannot {action}: custom rule(s) {names} pin a value of this watch; detach or delete the rule(s) first

propertywatch.name_exists: a property watch named ''{name}'' already exists

cost.label: QRadar capacity benchmark: how fast the rule could be evaluated. Lower is costlier to evaluate. This is not a firing rate.
cost.unit: millions of events per second (QRadar''s unit)

silent.excluded: Only EVENT rules and EVENT building blocks are judged: an event search sees every one of their matches. COMMON rules also match on flows, which are not searched, so their silence is unknown. FLOW and OFFENSE rules are not searched at all.

window.incomplete: Only {complete} of {expected} windows in the span are complete ({missing} missing, {truncated} truncated, {failed} failed). Absence from an incomplete window proves nothing.
window.none: No rule-match window has been collected for this instance: collection is disabled or has not run yet, so nothing is measured.
window.unsettled: No rule-match window in the requested span has settled yet.
